raw_text: {"overall_diagnosis":"All diagnosis samples converge on the same issue: the single-quarter holdings summary guidance in 13f-analyzer/SKILL.md uses ambiguous quantity semantics for holdings counts. Users can therefore answer questions like ‘How many stocks are held by Renaissance?’ incorrectly by counting all rows instead of distinct stock positions filtered to the approved stock universe. For tasks asking how many stocks a fund holds, the intended metric should be unique stock positions (unique CUSIPs) after applying the helper’s stock-universe filter based on TITLEOFCLASS equity/common-stock-style classes.","repair_instruction":"Revise the single-quarter holdings summary documentation to explicitly define each metric reported by the helper: (1) total holdings/positions = count of INFOTABLE rows for the accession_number and quarter; (2) total AUM = sum(VALUE) for that fund-quarter; (3) total stocks held = count of unique CUSIPs after applying the skill’s approved stock-universe filter (TITLEOFCLASS common-equity-like whitelist used by the helper). Add explicit guidance that questions asking ‘How many stocks are held?’ must use the unique-stock-count metric rather than raw row count.
